title: Shared primitive types for the agent harness

schemaVersion.description: SemVer of the schema this document conforms to.

agentId.description: Stable identity, e.g. agent:claude-opus-5:a3f9 or human:rickchow.

sessionId.description: UTC start timestamp to the minute plus a 4-hex disambiguator.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601, UTC only, second precision. Offsets are rejected so that lexical ordering equals chronological ordering.

base64.description: Prefixed so a key material blob never reads as an ordinary string in a diff.

relPath.description: Project-relative POSIX path. Absolute paths, drive letters and backslash separators are rejected in PathGuard rather than here — a regex is too weak to be the only check.

secretTier.description: A = long-lived credential (reference only, never sealed). B = short-lived token (sealable, must carry expires_at). C = non-secret config (plaintext).
